newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Polish banks see end-97 CPI at 15.73 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Polish banks see end-97 CPI at 15.73 pct.

text.p: Inflation expectations among Polish banks fell in April after last month's rise, a monthly Reuter poll of the 26 biggest banks showed on Thursday.
Banks predicted average year-on-year inflation for the end of 1997 at 15.73 percent, down from 16.27 percent predicted last month but well above the government's goal of 13 percent.
In February year-on-year inflation was 17.3 percent.
Banks predicted monthly inflation this month against March would be 1.13 percent on average with a range of forecasts from 0.6 to 1.9 percent. @
Banks predicted year-on-year inflation in April 1998 at an average 14.47 percent, with the range from 12.5 to 16.7 percent.
